record.original_question: For the 1993 model with state variables p0,i(x,t), p1,i(x,t), p2(x,u,t), p3(x,t), and p4(x,u,t), representing a two-unit parallel system with operating, repair, waiting-for-repair, and suspended-repair states; with a1 > 0 the Erlang-distribution parameter, a2(x) the repair rate of unit 1, b1(x) the life rate, b2(x) the repair rate of unit 2, and boundary data including p0,1(0,t) = integral from 0 to infinity of p1,1(x,t) b2(x) dx + delta(t), determine whether the PDE model is well posed and determine the asymptotic behavior of its time-dependent solution.

evidence.quote: Where (x, u, t) in [0, infinity) x [0, infinity) x [0, infinity); p0,i(x, t) is the probability that at time t two units are operating and the operating unit 1 is in phase i, and the age of unit 2 is x; p1,i(x, t) is the probability that at time t unit 1 is operating, the operating phase is i and unit 2 is being repaired and the elapsed time of the failed unit 2 is x; p2(x, u, t) is the probability that at time t unit 2 is operating and unit 1 is being repaired, the elapsed repair time of the failed unit 1 is x, and the age of unit 2 is u; p3(x, t) is the probability that at time t unit 1 is being repaired and unit 2 is waiting for repair, and the elapsed repair time of the failed unit 1 is x; p4(x, u, t) is the probability that at time t unit 1 is being repaired and unit 2 is in suspended repair, and the elapsed repair time of the failed unit 1 is x and the elapsed time of the failed unit 2 is u; a1 > 0 is a constant parameter of the Erlang distribution; a2(x) is the repair rate of unit 1; b1(x) is the life rate; b2(x) is the repair rate of unit 2; delta(.) is the Dirac-delta function.
Well-posedness of the above model and asymptotic behavior of its time-dependent solution have not been obtained until today.

artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not return any paper proving well-posedness or asymptotic behavior of this specific 1993 Li-type two-unit parallel model with Erlang-distributed lifetime, suspended repair state, and the indicated boundary conditions. While the broader program of analyzing such reliability PDE models via C_0-semigroup theory (initiated by Gupur and coauthors) has settled many related two- and three-unit systems, the precise model in question does not appear to have been resolved in the literature located.

status_evidence.title: Dynamic analysis of a complex system under preemptive repeat repair discipline
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of two-unit complex systems with supplementary variable techniques described by PDEs with integral boundary conditions; proves unique nonnegative time-dependent solution and exponential convergence to steady-state for related models.
status_evidence.claim: Related but distinct two-unit reliability PDE models have been resolved by C_0-semigroup methods, while the specific Li 1993 model is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Well-Posedness of Gaver's Parallel System Attended by a Cold Standby Unit and a Repairman with Multiple Vacations
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes well-posedness for a related parallel-repair model via semigroup theory.
status_evidence.claim: Similar techniques have been applied to other parallel repairable systems, indicating an active program but not covering the specific Li 1993 model.
